title: ranunculus acris subsp. glabriusculus
intro: Ranunculus acris subsp. glabriusculus, commonly known as alpine buttercup, is a plant species belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of alpine buttercup are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit analgesic and anti-edematous effects. The bioactive constituents of alpine buttercup include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
